newsitem.title: CONGO: Angolan cargo plane crashes in Congo, three dead.
newsitem.headline: Angolan cargo plane crashes in Congo, three dead.

text.p: An Angolan cargo plane crashed on take off from Congo's capital Brazzaville, killing three of the seven people on board, state radio reported on Tuesday.
The four survivors of Monday's crash at Brazzaville's Maya-Maya international airport were all injured but ferried to hospital in a U.S. military helicopter, it said.
The plane, a Fokker 27, belonged to the Angolan national airline TAAG.
The cause of the crash was not immediately known.

U.S., French, Belgian and British forces are deployed in Brazzaville to evacuate their nationals from Zaire's capital in the event of violence linked to efforts by rebels and opponents of President Mobutu Sese Seko to topple the veteran leader.
